newsitem.title: INDIA: State Bank of India planning to retail gilts.
newsitem.headline: State Bank of India planning to retail gilts.

text.p: The State Bank of India (SBI) is planning to set up a network of branches in metropolitan and urban areas to promote retail marketing of government securities, bank chairman P.G. Kakodkar said on Wednesday.
"We will select a number of branches with high-value accounts and good safe custody facilities to start with," Kakodkar said.
"We are working on the proposal," he said.
The secondary market for securities could develop only by broadening the investor base and this could be done by reaching out to the retail investor, he said.
Kakodkar said credit offtake had picked up in SBi in the last two weeks and felt that it coincided with the onset of the busy season.
